summary: Retain runtime for disconnecting an IntersectionObserver from all targets.

target.notes: Remove all observation targets; the observer object can later observe again.

caveats: Disconnect does not model a simple event subscription because observation state lives in the rendering pipeline.

tests.name: disconnect removes all targets
tests.input: const o=new IntersectionObserver(()=>{}); const e=document.createElement('div'); o.observe(e); o.disconnect();
tests.expected_behavior: no future entries arise for e unless observed again

tests.name: observer is reusable
tests.input: const o=new IntersectionObserver(()=>{}); const e=document.createElement('div'); o.disconnect(); o.observe(e);
tests.expected_behavior: e can be observed after disconnect
